notes_for_editor: Thin record: a county list, the FFLA type and status row, and one peakbagging table row. Do not merge with NHLR US 1349, CA 172, the Sugarloaf Lookout in Shasta County (standing, Shasta-Trinity NF, coordinates 40.914, -122.445), which is a different tower on a different row of the firelookout.org table. Our Tuolumne record has no registry numbers and the sources show none. The Tuolumne county list gives SUGARLOAF with no agency line, so no agency is recorded. Elevation 3,881 ft comes from the peakbagging row; the table's column order was read from its header and neighbouring rows. listsofjohn.com, which gives the same 3,881 ft for the peak, returned HTTP 403 to the fetch tool and is not used. Story is short because the sources hold little.
